notes: This JSON is the ER/documentation manifest consumed by render_er_diagram.py.
The production schema should be implemented through SQLAlchemy models and Flask-Migrate migrations; update this manifest and diagram whenever the model schema changes.
Role opt-in is represented by users + roles + user_roles. Kitchen and organization membership are separate authorization relationships.
external_opportunities are intentionally separate from events until a listing is reviewed/imported; no payment-card credentials are stored.
Matching recommendations can be computed dynamically; no persisted matches table is needed for the MVP.

locations.description: Reusable physical locations used by people, organizations, kitchens, and events.
checks: latitude IS NULL OR latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90
longitude IS NULL OR longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180

users.description: A single account may opt into multiple roles; mealsync_id is the human-facing unique identifier used for referrals.

roles.description: The four opt-in application roles: VOLUNTEER, DONOR, ORGANIZATION, COMMUNITY_KITCHEN.

user_roles.description: Many-to-many mapping that permits a user to activate any combination of roles.

organizations.description: NGOs or organizing bodies that create events and may operate multiple kitchens.

organization_members.description: Maps registered users to organizations with a scoped authorization role.

community_kitchens.description: Kitchen is its own entity and may be independent (organization_id NULL) or attached to an organization.

kitchen_members.description: Users with explicit membership in a kitchen; role can be manager, coordinator, chef, or staff.

kitchen_hours.description: Recurring opening/availability windows. Multiple windows on one weekday are allowed.

skills.description: Controlled vocabulary of volunteer/event skills (cooking, packing, distribution, driving, cleaning, etc.).

volunteer_profiles.description: Volunteer-specific profile and matching preferences; account identity remains in users.

volunteer_skills.description: Many-to-many mapping between volunteers and their claimed skills.

volunteer_availability.description: Queryable recurring weekly availability or one-off date-specific availability, optionally tied to a location.
checks: weekday IS NULL OR weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6
(is_recurring = true AND weekday IS NOT NULL) OR (is_recurring = false AND availability_date IS NOT NULL)

events.description: Canonical, locally managed volunteer or meal-service events. A kitchen may operate independently of an NGO.
checks: organization_id IS NOT NULL OR kitchen_id IS NOT NULL

event_required_skills.description: Skills/competency needed for an event; used by the volunteer matching heuristic.

event_volunteers.description: Volunteer applications/registrations for events, including approval and attendance tracking.

volunteer_referrals.description: A volunteer can refer another registered user to a specific event using their MealSync identity.

opportunity_sources.description: Whitelisted/public websites or platforms from which opportunities may be imported; respect robots.txt and site terms.

external_opportunities.description: Imported/aggregated listings kept separate from first-party events so duplicate and stale records can be controlled.

kitchen_event_requests.description: A kitchen's request to host/support an event; the kitchen can accept or decline a request floated by an organizer.

donation_requests.description: A public request/campaign for money, ingredients, food, equipment, or other resources.
checks: organization_id IS NOT NULL OR kitchen_id IS NOT NULL OR event_id IS NOT NULL

donations.description: A donor's pledge or contribution against a request; do not store payment-card/bank credentials here.

ingredients.description: Normalized catalogue of food ingredients and their base units.

kitchen_inventory.description: Current stock level for each ingredient at each kitchen; update it transactionally with inventory_transactions.

vendors.description: Ingredient/equipment suppliers associated with kitchens' procurement workflows.

vendor_ingredients.description: Supplier catalogue/quote for ingredient and unit, including most recently recorded price.

purchase_orders.description: Kitchen purchase order header for supplier procurement.
checks: expected_delivery_date IS NULL OR expected_delivery_date >= order_date

purchase_order_items.description: Line items of a purchase order; partial receipt is supported.

inventory_transactions.description: Append-only stock movement ledger. quantity_delta is signed; service code keeps it and kitchen_inventory consistent in one transaction.

recipes.description: Recipes, optionally owned by a specific kitchen; NULL kitchen_id means shared/global recipe.

recipe_ingredients.description: Ingredient quantities normalized per serving so planned inventory use can scale with servings.

chefs.description: Kitchen-specific chef profile; a chef may be a registered user or a staff member entered by a kitchen manager.

meal_schedules.description: Scheduled recipe preparation at a kitchen with planned/actual serving counts and a lifecycle status.

meal_schedule_chefs.description: Many-to-many assignment allowing multiple chefs to share a recipe schedule and responsibility.

meal_demand.description: One daily demand record per kitchen; supports estimates now and historical actual counts for later forecasting.
checks: confidence IS NULL OR confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1

food_surplus.description: Tracks prepared meals remaining after service and what happened to the surplus.

food_wastage.description: Logs wasted ingredients or prepared food, including reason and traceable kitchen/user context.
checks: ingredient_id IS NOT NULL OR recipe_id IS NOT NULL

notifications.description: In-app notifications for referrals, event approvals, donations, and kitchen requests.
